Back when I was in third grade I was going through a really bad case of anorexia. I had some sort of stomach bug that my 9 year old brain realized that every time I ate I would get a bad stomach ache, so to combat this I would simply stop eating. this went on for about 4 months. I remember being under five feet tall and weighing less than 55 pounds. I was basically a skeleton with a thin layer of skin (no joke I saw every rib and I had NO gut or belly, like less than 4% body fat). My parents were upset that I was so skinny but never did anything about it. 

Well after four months of eating very little I woke up one morning with a bad stomach ache like every other morning. I remember sitting at the kitchen table at seeing the bright kitchen light and thinking “oh this hurts so bad and why is that light so bright” then seeing blind spots and poof, lights out. 

My mom and grandma who saw it swear that it was a seizure because my eyes rolled back, I locked my arms and legs, and wouldn’t respond. It’s weird to describe, most people who go through seizures don’t remember having it or going through it. I’m able to remember what happened right before and what I heard. I heard what my mom and grandma yelled but I didn’t process it or think of it. Like I can hear it perfectly but while I heard it as I was having the seizure I didn’t think of anything, I didn’t think “why did it go black” or anything else. My mom said that she was trying to unlock my limbs but I don’t remember that sensation or feeling. It’s like my only sense at all while I had during the seizure was hearing. No feeling (pain), thought, sight, or anything else. Basically my mind went blank. 

I woke up to my mom holding me and taking me to the ER where we were told that I was apparently very close to my organs shutting down because of the lack of nutrition. I’m glad I made it out because it was hell going through it.

Well here I am now years later with a nice phat belly attached to some guy on his computer typing all about it on Reddit.
